rationale: 64% = 2398 rpm = 85% of the 2830 max. Raised from 56% (2163 rpm, 76%) after a live audit found the CPU reaching 88.6 C with the radiator already demanding 100% - flow was the only lever left, since the radiator cannot be asked for more than full speed. Still a FIXED duty, which is the property that actually protects the pump: speed cycling is the wear mechanism, not steady rpm. Still far below maximum, and far above the low-rpm cavitation range that does real damage. Drop back to 56.0 if pump noise becomes objectionable; the measured map is below.
